job.name: l3_board_d
job.meaning: дизайн-система ролика о телефонных мошенниках на основе брендбука «Reels-эксперт» (палитра и шрифты оттуда) с нашим экспертом; Вариант D «Классический»: СВЕТЛЫЙ белый фон, строгая сетка, чёрный текст, жёлтый — только акцентная подсветка, красный — только предупреждения; без мазков кисти, без гранжа, без штампов-печатей, без глитча; спокойный, чистый, деловой вид — должен РЕЗКО отличаться от тёмных вариантов
job.prompt: Create a complete design system board (brand style guide sheet) for SHORT VERTICAL 9:16 expert videos. The FIRST attached image is the approved brand board «Reels-эксперт» — take the WHOLE brand book from it: palette (deep black #0E0E10, acid yellow #FFE600, alarm red #FF3B30, white #FFFFFF, grey #8E8E93), typography (Unbounded Black headlines, Montserrat ExtraBold subheads), its icon style, stamps, brush strokes, decorative elements and principles — and keep the same block structure (hero, colour palette with HEX, typography, presenter style, graphic elements, icons/stickers, infographic examples, decorative elements, footer principles). The SECOND attached image is our presenter: use EXACTLY this man (same face, short dark-blond hair, stubble, black shirt) everywhere on the board instead of the man on the first board. All text in Russian, short and correctly spelled. Hero title: «Как не попасться телефонным мошенникам». IMPORTANT: a block «ВЕРТИКАЛЬНЫЕ КАДРЫ 9:16» with 6 phone-shaped frames showing SIX DIFFERENT LAYOUTS of this video: (1) presenter full frame + an incoming-call card «Служба безопасности банка» with a red stamp «ОПАСНО»; (2) full-screen typography without the presenter: a huge «3» and «признака мошенника»; (3) presenter lower-right, numbered stickers on the left: «1 Торопит и пугает», «2 Просит код из СМС» with a crossed-out code «••••»; (4) presenter's face in a viewfinder frame on top, below «Безопасный счёт» and a red stamp «НЕ СУЩЕСТВУЕТ»; (5) presenter on the left, on the right a red «положите трубку» button then a yellow «перезвоните сами» button and a bank card back with the phone number highlighted; (6) presenter full frame with the takeaway «1 минута паузы = деньги целы». Every frame has a big subtitle bar at the bottom with ONE word highlighted in yellow. No real bank names or logos. VARIANT D «Классический»: it must look COMPLETELY DIFFERENT from the dark grungy original — a calm, clean, classic editorial/explainer style. WHITE and very light grey (#F4F4F5) backgrounds everywhere (board blocks AND all six phone frames), black Unbounded headlines, Montserrat body, a strict grid with generous white space, thin black rules and simple flat rectangles. Acid yellow #FFE600 is used ONLY as a flat highlighter rectangle behind one key word and for number badges; alarm red #FF3B30 ONLY for warning labels as clean flat pills (NOT rubber stamps). Simple uniform outline icons in black. NO brush strokes, NO grunge, NO rubber-stamp textures, NO glitch, NO halftone, NO hand-drawn arrows. The presenter photo is cut out and placed on the light background (or in a clean rectangular frame with a thin black border). Subtitle bar: white with black text and the highlighted word on a yellow rectangle. Mood: calm, trustworthy, classic, premium-clean.
